name: Heatmap
description: Cross-tabulation as a color-coded grid — cell color shows frequency, mean, or sum per (X, G) combination.
whenToUse: Show a value or a count for every combination of two categories as a colour grid — e.g. cycle time per shift and line.
placeholderPickBoth: Pick two categorical columns (X and G). Optionally a numeric value column (V) — otherwise the heatmap shows frequencies.
